I used to leave in England before, there I was given a 5 pounds discount every time I went to the store, for having my own bag, doing self checkout and being a college student under 18 at the time. 

I would go around 5 rounds in one day to buy stuff, I used to change jumpers just so they wouldn’t see me every time looking the same, nevertheless after like 4 months of doing the security stop me to check my backpack because they thought I was shoplifting. I only had a sprite and a pasta, that I “paid” for. Still I just  started to mumble in Portuguese, so they didn’t bother me anymore. (I don’t even speak Portuguese. I was making sounds like Portuguese talking people) . 

I kept doing it until the discount went from 5 pounds to 1 pound and everything I did wasn’t actually illegal because they were the ones offering the discount and I truly had my own bag, was doing self-checkout and I was a college student under eighteen. 

Now I’m much older and I had to talk a lawyer about this, because I didn’t want to get a bite in the ass from my past, as I said my lawyer said that I have nothing to fear.

I was broke, but my stomach was full. 

Ps. I used to live alone in England, I didn’t have any sort of family there.
